content.value_statement: Computer vision projects often fail when prototypes must become reliable production systems. This skill guides architecture, training, optimization, deployment, and monitoring for vision AI workflows.
actual_capabilities: Guides architecture choices for image, video, object detection, and segmentation systems.
Provides production planning for latency, throughput, availability, monitoring, and cost targets.
Outlines model training, evaluation, deployment, and drift monitoring workflows.
Offers local placeholder scripts for trainer, optimizer, and dataset pipeline entry points.
Documents security, privacy, access control, and audit logging considerations for vision systems.
limitations: The included scripts are scaffolds and do not implement real model training or optimization logic.
It does not include datasets, pretrained weights, or benchmark results.
Deployment commands are examples and must be adapted to the user environment.
It cannot guarantee model accuracy without data quality review and experimental validation.

use_cases.title: Design a Vision Architecture
use_cases.description: Plan components, model serving, observability, and scaling for a new image or video AI system.

use_cases.title: Optimize Object Detection Inference
use_cases.description: Review bottlenecks, batching, caching, hardware choices, and deployment settings for lower latency.

use_cases.title: Prepare Production Readiness Reviews
use_cases.description: Check monitoring, privacy controls, error handling, model drift plans, and release practices before launch.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Vision Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a computer vision pipeline for [task]. Include data inputs, model options, evaluation metrics, and deployment steps.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Detection Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this object detection system and suggest improvements for accuracy, latency, throughput, and monitoring. Context: [system details].

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Production Deployment
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a production readiness plan for this vision model. Cover security, privacy, scaling, rollback, drift detection, and incident response.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Vision Platform Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Act as a senior computer vision architect and critique this design. Identify failure modes, cost risks, model risks, and operational gaps: [design].

output_examples.input: A team needs a real-time defect detection service for a factory line.
output: Recommended architecture with camera ingestion, preprocessing, model serving, and alert routing.
Latency and throughput targets for each stage of the pipeline.
Monitoring plan for false positives, missed detections, drift, and camera health.

output_examples.input: An object detection model is accurate offline but slow in production.
output: Prioritized bottleneck review covering preprocessing, batch size, model format, hardware, and network overhead.
Optimization options such as quantization, pruning, caching, and asynchronous processing.
Validation checklist to protect accuracy while improving inference speed.

output_examples.input: A manager wants a launch checklist for a segmentation model handling user images.
output: Readiness checklist for privacy, access control, logging, retention, and audit review.
Release plan with canary rollout, rollback triggers, and post-launch metrics.
Operational ownership model for incidents, retraining, and data quality issues.

best_practices: Define accuracy, latency, throughput, and privacy requirements before selecting a model architecture.
Validate data quality and edge cases before optimizing training or deployment infrastructure.
Monitor production predictions, input drift, resource usage, and user impact after release.
anti_patterns: Do not treat demo accuracy as production readiness without real workload testing.
Do not run deployment examples against shared infrastructure without reviewing targets and access rights.
Do not optimize latency before measuring the full pipeline and confirming the actual bottleneck.

faq.question: Does this skill train a real model by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and placeholder scripts. Users must implement training logic and supply data.

faq.question: Can it help with object detection systems?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers architecture, optimization, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring for detection workflows.

faq.question: Does it support video processing use cases?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes guidance for real-time processing, batching, throughput, and monitoring.

faq.question: Which tools and frameworks does it mention?
faq.answer: It references Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV-related workflows, Docker, Kubernetes, and common MLOps tools.

faq.question: Is the skill safe for automated installation?
faq.answer: The audit found documentation examples and placeholder scripts. Review commands before running them in production environments.

faq.question: What should users provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide task goals, data details, model constraints, target hardware, latency needs, and deployment context.
